evidence.V1: Front and three-quarter read instantly as a wall with a mullioned window; centred opening; slab silhouette appropriate for a module.
evidence.V2: Clear: wall slab, medium window frame/sill/cap/plinth, small mullion cross and gold keystone.
evidence.V3: Window is small for an 8x12 panel and sits over a blank dark apron; proportions stiff.
evidence.V4: Consistent chamfers on stones, frame, sill and keystone; sill close-up shows clean bevel catching light.
evidence.V5: Window, sill and end-section close-ups clean; no seams or z-fighting.
evidence.V6: Stone greys, light frame, timber mullions, gold keystone; glass a muted blue-grey - still disciplined.
evidence.V7: 664 tris vs module target 800 - under target.
evidence.V8: Kit materials and accents used correctly, but the plain dark apron under the sill breaks the coursed stonework and the blue glass is outside the listed palette.
evidence.V9: Anchored, Box (or Default) collision, CanTouch off, Color white, grid-corner pivot; T1 tiling passes.

top_fixes: Enlarge the window (taller opening) and course stones under the sill instead of the blank apron
Tint glass toward the kit steel grey or ink
Add a slightly deeper reveal/lintel stone above the frame for weight
